title: NIST NCSTAR 1A Final Report on the Collapse of WTC 7
intended_use: official findings; three-stage roofline measurement; model-observation comparison
limitations: agency-authored; summary report; not an independent replication

title: NIST NCSTAR 1-9 Structural Fire Response and Probable Collapse Sequence
intended_use: nine-camera method; synchronized observation timeline; audio analysis; lateral displacement
limitations: agency-authored; most cameras north of site; lower structure often obscured

title: NIST NCSTAR 1-9A Global Structural Analysis
intended_use: LS-DYNA handoff; instantaneous damage application; 3.5 h and 4.0 h cases
limitations: agency-authored; executable model and some inputs/results not publicly reproducible

title: NIST WTC 7 Investigation FAQs
intended_use: agency explanations of free fall; model-video mismatch; blast inquiry; steel availability
limitations: FAQ is advocacy/explanation by investigating agency; use report for technical detail

title: NIST Disaster and Failure Studies Repository
intended_use: provenance route for native or near-native photos/video and metadata
limitations: tags are incomplete; copyright/ownership must be tracked separately from evidentiary preservation and authentication

title: NIST revised WTC 7 technical briefing
intended_use: contemporaneous explanation of model and video findings
limitations: agency presentation; condensed

title: WTC Building 7 Collapse - 27 Angles
intended_use: qualitative cross-angle orientation; audio-source discovery; distinguish spoken explosion accounts from recorded transients
limitations: preserved as separate platform video/audio streams; compilation contains edits crops re-encoding voiceovers silent gaps and mixed source audio; not suitable for physical SPL or precise cross-clip timing

title: A Structural Reevaluation of the Collapse of World Trade Center 7
intended_use: independent challenge; open model/data; imposed failure patterns
limitations: funded by Architects & Engineers for 9/11 Truth; not proof of the cause of imposed failures; requires independent technical audit

title: The Collapse of World Trade Center 7: Revisited
intended_use: alternative fire-driven mechanism; demonstrates mechanism non-uniqueness
limitations: model-based hypothesis; authors state exact cause cannot be known from available evidence

title: Analysis of Structural Response of WTC 7 to Fire and Sequential Failures Leading to Collapse
intended_use: peer-reviewed condensed account of NIST structural analysis
limitations: journal review is not an independent rerun of withheld executable files

title: Camera 2/3/4 files accompanying independent multi-point motion analysis
source_owner: Chandler; Walter; Szamboti / International Center for 9/11 Justice
intended_use: reproduce and audit multi-point roofline measurements; compare copies against higher-generation sources
limitations: secondary-hosted copies attributed to NIST footage; Camera 2 is expressly labeled converted; not authenticated masters; advocacy-affiliated source

title: CNN September 11 2001 15:45-16:26 archive segment
intended_use: preserve and time the pre-collapse CNN reports that WTC 7 had collapsed or was collapsing and later might collapse
limitations: 512 kb archive derivative; segment start time is an archive label rather than embedded original timecode; not a broadcaster master

title: BBC September 11 2001 16:54-17:36 archive segment
intended_use: preserve and time BBC statements that the Salomon Brothers Building had collapsed before its observed collapse
limitations: 512 kb archive derivative; segment start time is an archive label rather than embedded original timecode; not a broadcaster master

title: CNN breaking-news transcript after WTC 7 collapse
intended_use: corroborate that police and fire personnel expected collapse and had cleared the area before the event
limitations: post-event recollection by a producer; not a contemporaneous official log; does not identify collapse mechanism

title: Request for Correction to NIST WTC 7 Report
intended_use: locate the CNN street-level warning clip and preserve the challengers' transcription and interpretation
limitations: preserved from files.wtc7report.org and hashed; advocacy submission; quotation is on p. 59 and cites YouTube ID 3LUC2QaZ9kQ; the 63-second video stream was not obtainable through the unauthenticated downloader; highest-generation uncut copy and independent synchronization remain necessary

title: Part of the conspiracy?
intended_use: BBC's later account of how its premature WTC 7 report arose
limitations: retrospective institutional explanation; underlying contemporaneous Reuters wire copy correction and newsroom logs should be obtained

title: CNN Footage of WTC 7 Noise and Comments
intended_use: locate and test audible pre-collapse warning after reported noise
limitations: YouTube ID 3LUC2QaZ9kQ; unlisted 63-second secondary upload; metadata retrieved but video stream unavailable to unauthenticated downloader; not preserved or authenticated; uncut broadcaster source required

title: 7 World Trade Center Videos
intended_use: trace source clips and flag versions with different added withheld or missing audio
limitations: advocacy page with causal claims not adopted here; preserved HTML is an index of leads rather than authentication; linked media and assertions require independent verification

title: Hertz Tower Demolition FAQs
intended_use: confirms planned implosion and project facts for a high-rise comparator
limitations: does not provide full charge plan or instrument data

title: Capital One Tower Implosion - Lake Charles
intended_use: qualitative video-and-audio positive control for an officially identified explosive implosion
limitations: separate platform video/audio streams preserved; single viewpoint; no calibrated camera or microphone; not used for source-SPL or precise acceleration

title: News Clip: Landmark Tower Implosion
intended_use: archival high-rise explosive-implosion comparator
limitations: news edit; no charge plan or calibrated motion extraction

title: Full Scale 13-Story Building Implosion and Collapse
intended_use: documented selected-column charges on alternating floors and progressive collapse
limitations: reinforced-concrete dormitories; geometry differs from WTC 7

title: Demolition prep heats up at Cather Pound halls
intended_use: documents extensive preparation and mixed demolition methods
limitations: institutional news; not an engineering analysis

title: Demolition de la Tour DEF a Vitry-sur-Seine
intended_use: nonexplosive induced-collapse visual comparator
limitations: access may be bot-gated; method and camera calibration not established by video page alone

title: HBI Facility induced and explosive collapse
intended_use: documents strategic weakening plus cable pull as a nonexplosive induced-collapse method
limitations: industrial structures differ in height geometry and framing

title: Evaluation of Plasco Building fire-induced progressive collapse
intended_use: accidental fire-collapse negative control; structural/video-based scenario testing
limitations: 16-story Iranian steel building; materially different framing and fire history

title: Structural investigation of the collapse of the 16-story Plasco building due to fire
source_owner: Structural Design of Tall and Special Buildings
intended_use: staged fire-induced collapse comparator
limitations: model-based reconstruction; not a demolition case
